returned_title: National Integrated Survey of Households (NISH): National Consumer Survey and Labour Force Surveys (1981–1986)
justification: Conducted by Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics (formerly Federal Office of Statistics), this survey series collected microdata across Nigerian states including Lagos during the 1980s on employment, household expenditures, market involvement, trade, and living conditions.

returned_title: World Values Survey / Integrated Values Surveys (1981–2022)
justification: A longitudinal cross-national survey dataset starting with Wave 1 (1981–1984) that measures social attitudes, community life, employment priorities, market/economic perceptions, and civic engagement.

returned_title: Nigeria - Public Delivery of Primary Health Care Services 2002 (World Bank Microdata Library)
justification: A World Bank facility and household survey microdata set focusing on urban Lagos and rural Kogi that evaluates community participation, local governance, and the availability and use of primary social services.

Houses historical and cross-national social, economic, labor, and community research data collections covering West Africa and Nigeria across key themes including trade, employment, urban life, and social services.

returned_title: Dataset of the survey on the digital transformation of business processes at universities in Germany

returned_title: Die Studierendenbefragung in Deutschland (2021) [The Student Survey in Germany 2021]
justification: A nationwide dataset collecting responses from over 170,000 university students in Germany in 2021, capturing data on digital learning conditions during the COVID-19 pandemic, social and economic background, and university policy implementation.

returned_title: Digitale Lernangebote zum Thema Künstliche Intelligenz
justification: This dataset provides an overview and mapping of free digital learning offerings and artificial intelligence courses across German higher education learning platforms in 2020, focusing on AI adoption and educational policy in German universities.

returned_title: Election and Social Data of the Districts and Municipalities of the German Empire from 1920 to 1933

returned_title: The German Local Population Database (GPOP), 1871 to 2019
justification: Contains historical municipal and county population census data for Germany across benchmark years starting in 1871, harmonized to modern spatial boundaries.

returned_title: Chronicling Germany: An Annotated Historical Newspaper Dataset
justification: Provides annotated pages, OCR, and layout segmentation data from historical German-language newspapers published between 1852 and 1924.

returned_title: Kölner Wahlstudie (Dortmund, Arnsberg-Soest, Heilbronn, München; Juli 1961)
justification: Conducted in July 1961 by Erwin K. Scheuch et al. and archived at GESIS, this study surveyed residents in urban (e.g., Dortmund) and rural (e.g., Arnsberg-Soest) administrative districts in North Rhine-Westphalia regarding social structures, community life, and local political views.

returned_title: Aids im Bewußtsein der Bevölkerung der DDR 1990
justification: This dataset from GESIS contains survey data collected in 1989–1990 by the GDR's Central Institute for Hygiene, Microbiology, and Epidemiology alongside the Institute for Sociology and Social Policy. Initiated in 1987 by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, GDR, this longitudinal study tracks physical and mental health, general well-being, and socio-psychological indicators of young people in East Germany through the late 1980s and 1990s.

Expanded into the GDR in June 1990 prior to official reunification, the Socio-Economic Panel dataset offers representative longitudinal microdata on general health, satisfaction, well-being, and living conditions in East Germany.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This study, conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in East Germany starting in 1968, surveyed youth in the GDR on topics including leisure activities, weekend routines, sports engagement, and cultural participation during the late 1960s.

returned_title: Special Eurobarometer 386: Europeans and Their Languages
justification: Conducted in 2012 across European Union member states (including Belgium, Germany, Spain, Greece, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Finland, Slovenia, Cyprus, Malta, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Sweden, UK, and Lithuania), this survey dataset measures citizens' language skills, language use in daily life and media, multilingualism, and attitudes toward language learning.

A comprehensive directory and dataset of digital media outlets in Spain and Portugal developed through research projects spanning the 2010s and early 2020s, mapping outlet typologies, primary language of operation, ownership structures, and digital media characteristics.

Fielded in 2010 across multiple European countries, this cross-national survey dataset records individual-level information regarding language spoken at home, minority language group identification, and detailed news media usage (television, radio, newspapers, and online media).

Led by the Centre for Media Pluralism and Media Freedom at the European University Institute, this monitoring infrastructure gathered systematic data across EU member states during the 2010s on media ownership concentration, protection of minority/regional languages in media, and public service media neutrality.

This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive contains survey data on Duisburg residents collected in Autumn 2000, covering urban living conditions, employment and vocational training opportunities, local infrastructure, community life, and social attitudes.

This dataset surveys Duisburg citizens in 2005, collecting data on living standards, municipal policies, safety and crime perceptions, leisure activities, family structures, and employment.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA6151) documents a 1970 survey wave conducted in the German Democratic Republic by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ). This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive (ZA6144) holds empirical survey data from 1973 in the German Democratic Republic conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ). Provides official registration data on protest movements, topics, dates, and participant numbers across major German cities (including Berlin) during the 2020s.

returned_title: ACLED Germany Conflict and Demonstration Event Data
justification: Tracks disaggregated protest, demonstration, and civil unrest events across Germany (including Berlin and nationwide farmers' protests) continuously from 2020 onwards.
Includes country-level modeling data for Germany evaluating agricultural policy pathways, food system security, land-use change, and agricultural emissions.

returned_title: RKI Open Data - Gesundheitsberichterstattung: Daten zu nichtübertragbaren Erkrankungen
justification: Maintained by the Robert Koch Institute, this dataset provides key indicators on public health, dietary behaviors, and nutrition policy/prevention outcomes in Germany for the 2020s.

returned_title: Political Action: An Eight Nation Study, 1973-1976
justification: This cross-national study conducted between 1973 and 1976 includes personal interviews with respondents in West Germany, capturing data on conventional and unconventional political participation, protest attitudes, and ideological orientations.

Contains multi-decade cross-national trend data on public attitudes toward government institutions, political participation, and voter behaviour in West Germany starting from 1970.
Provides institutional data on cabinet compositions, party affiliations, government duration, and parliamentary election outcomes in West Germany throughout the 1970s.
Survey dataset from the GESIS Data Archive containing pre-election and post-election panel survey data on voting behavior and political attitudes for the 1972 West German federal election.
Survey dataset from the GESIS Data Archive containing multi-wave panel survey data examining political choices and public opinion during the 1976 West German federal election.

returned_title: PSoGA: Sentence-level and manifesto-level social group appeals in party election manifestos across eight European democracies, 1970–2025
justification: Dataset hosted on Harvard Dataverse containing coded party election manifestos from 1970 to 2025 across eight European democracies, including German election campaign manifestos from the 1970s.

returned_title: Bildungsentwicklung in Deutschland: Allgemeinbildende Schulen 1960 bis 2000 (GESIS ZA8220)
justification: This GESIS dataset (ZA8220) provides historical time-series data on general education across German federal states (including Hesse) from 1960 to 2000, covering compulsory schooling, primary education, and pre-school classes.

returned_title: HISTAT - Allgemein bildende Schulen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1949–2010
justification: A GESIS historical statistical data collection compiled by Helmut Köhler containing time-series statistics for West German states (including Hesse) on compulsory school attendance, pre-school classes (Schulkindergärten), and primary/secondary enrollment from 1949 onwards.

The official open data portal of Hesse (Hessisches Statistisches Landesamt), offering datasets and statistical series on compulsory education, general schools, and regional educational figures in Hesse.

returned_title: Die Praktizierung des Jugendarbeitsschutzes in Hessen aus der Sicht Jugendlicher
justification: This GESIS Data Archive study (ZA1376) collects data on working conditions, employment protection, and social situation of youth and working children in the state of Hesse.

returned_title: GESIS Mikrozensus-Trendfile: Harmonisierung der Mikrozensen 1962 bis 2012
justification: This harmonized Microcensus dataset series compiled by GESIS includes representative household microdata from West Germany (including Hesse) starting in 1962, capturing child and family demographics.

Provides harmonized public-use individual and household microdata from the United States decennial censuses spanning 1950 through the 2000s, enabling historical demographic, economic, and social analysis.

Tracks political attitudes, social history, and electoral behavior in England/Great Britain through general election surveys conducted continuously from 1964 through the 1970s, 1980s, 1990s, and 2000s.

Hosted via the Swedish National Data Service (SND), this series collects data on political attitudes, policy preferences, and electoral history in Sweden for every national election from 1956 through the 2000s.

returned_title: System of Social Indicators for the Federal Republic of Germany
justification: Maintained by GESIS, this dataset offers quantitative time-series indicators measuring social conditions, welfare, and quality of life across key living domains in West Germany and West Berlin from 1950 onward.

Digitized by the Zentral- und Landesbibliothek Berlin (ZLB), this historical statistical volume published by the Statistisches Landesamt Berlin provides official statistics and social indicators on demography, housing, and living conditions in Berlin around 1950.

returned_title: USIA Public Opinion Surveys on International Relations and Political Attitudes (GESIS ZA0381)

returned_title: German Youth and Authority (1950-1951) / Deutsche Jugend und Autorität

A 1953 representative sample dataset by Erich Reigrotzki archived at GESIS, containing individual-level demographic, occupational, and socio-political data across age cohorts, including post-war youth and displaced populations in West Berlin and West Germany.

returned_title: Perception of Old Age and Provision for Old Age among Workers and Employees (1955) / Altersbild und Altersvorsorge der Arbeiter und Angestellten 1955

returned_title: The Economics of Density: Evidence from the Berlin Wall (Dataset)
justification: This dataset provides spatial economic data, employment numbers, and land values across thousands of city blocks in Berlin before, during (including the post-WWII division in the 1950s), and after reunification to analyze economic activity in East and West Berlin.

returned_title: HISTAT - Historical Time Series on German Economic and Social History

returned_title: GENESIS-Online Database: Public Finance Time Series (Statistisches Bundesamt)

The official statistical database of Germany's Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) hosts historical vital and health statistics, including annual records on births, total fertility rates, and abortion statistics for both West and East Germany throughout the 1970s.

Managed by the Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research and the Vienna Institute of Demography, HFC offers supplementary historical fertility estimates, survey data, and age-specific birth data covering East and West Germany during the 1970s.

returned_title: Sociological Problems of a Special Epidemiology of HIV Infections 1989
justification: This GESIS dataset (ZA6890) contains survey and epidemiological research data on HIV/AIDS in the German Democratic Republic (GDR), collected in 1989 by the Institute for Sociology and Social Policy and the Central Institute for Hygiene, Microbiology, and Epidemiology of the GDR.

returned_title: Suicide, demographic, socio-structural, infrastructure and crime statistics of the German Democratic Republic, 1952 – 1990
justification: This dataset provides official, previously confidential annual statistics on suicides—a major cause of death and mental health indicator—along with demographic and socio-structural data in the German Democratic Republic, covering the period from 1952 to 1990 including the entire 1980s.

Eurostat's harmonized enterprise-level survey launched in 1992 (CIS 1) and 1996/1997 (CIS 2) covers business innovation, organizational restructuring, management strategies, and industrial practices across European countries including Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain during the 1990s.

Distributed via the UK Data Service, this microdataset provides representative data on workplace organization, human resource management practices, employee consultation, and industrial relations across business establishments in Great Britain in 1998.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 44.3OVR: Second European Survey on Working Conditions (1996)
justification: Commissioned by Eurofound and archived at GESIS, this dataset surveyed employees and workplaces in 1996 across EU member states (including Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain), measuring work organization, structural job characteristics, and workplace management practices.
This enterprise-level dataset hosted by the UK Data Service tracks business management, organizational practices, innovation investments, and firm strategy starting from its 1994 wave.

Conducted by Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics (formerly the Federal Office of Statistics), this household survey provides microdata on household composition, income, consumption patterns, and living conditions across urban and rural sectors, including Lagos State in 1980.

returned_title: Atlas of Urban Expansion - Lagos Dataset
justification: Provides spatial, demographic, and density datasets documenting urban growth, land cover changes, and suburban vs. rural built-up area transitions in Lagos starting from 1984.

returned_title: USGS EarthExplorer - Historical Landsat Imagery for Lagos (1980s)
justification: Hosts Landsat satellite imagery datasets covering Lagos during the 1980s, enabling researchers to map historical urban sprawl, land use changes, and peri-urban rural transformations.

returned_title: IPUMS DHS - Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys
justification: Provides harmonized survey data covering household demographics, urban/rural residence, fertility, and community health indicators in Nigeria, including regional coverage for Lagos.

This dataset contains electoral and demographic data at the constituency (Wahlkreis) and state levels for all German Reichstag elections from 1871 to 1912, directly covering political history across the 1870s, 1880s, 1890s, 1900s, and 1910s.

returned_title: The German Local Population Database (GPOP), 1871 to 2019
justification: A comprehensive database providing local population statistics for all municipalities, counties, and states in Germany, including historical census data for 1871 and 1910 during the German Empire period.

returned_title: Grunddaten der Bevölkerungsstatistik Deutschlands von 1871 bis 1939 (GESIS ZA8295)
justification: Archived in the GESIS Data Archive, this dataset contains systematic demographic and population statistics for the German Reich, its constituent states, and Prussian provinces from 1871 to 1939.

returned_title: MPIDR Census Mosaic: German Empire Historical GIS Datafiles
justification: Provides historical GIS shapefiles and administrative boundary datasets for the German Empire (1871–1945), capturing annual changes in regional and state administrative divisions throughout the 1870s to 1910s.

returned_title: Chronicling Germany: An Annotated Historical Newspaper Dataset
justification: A digital history dataset containing layout and text annotations for historical German-language newspapers published between 1852 and 1924, covering press and media history throughout the German Empire.

This dataset (GESIS ZA2653) investigates the transformation of housing environments, local community structures, and urban living conditions across selected East German municipal districts following the collapse of the GDR during the early 1990s transition period.
Conducted in the early 1990s, this dataset (GESIS ZA2425) documents the urban and rural background, housing situations, community mobility, and integration experiences of former GDR citizens.

This dataset (GESIS ZA6413) provides quantitative records of public grievances (Eingaben) submitted by GDR citizens between 1970 and 1989, documenting quality of life, local community issues, and urban/rural infrastructure problems across East German municipalities.

This longitudinal panel dataset (GESIS ZA6213 et seq.) tracks East German youth from late GDR times (1987) through the 1990s transition, surveying local community integration, political attitudes, and changing urban and rural living conditions in Saxony.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Relations and Support Systems / Social Networks II - ISSP 2001
justification: This cross-national survey dataset from the International Social Survey Programme (GESIS study ZA3680) is classified under the CESSDA topic 'SOCIAL STRATIFICATION AND GROUPINGS'. It covers social relations, networks, and social stratification indicators collected in 2001 across all 28 requested countries/territories: Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, New Zealand, Northern Ireland, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Russian Federation, Slovenia, Spain, South Africa, Switzerland, and the United States of America.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Inequality IV - ISSP 2009
justification: This cross-national survey dataset from the ISSP (GESIS study ZA5400) investigates social inequality, class stratification, social mobility, wage equity, and group conflicts across participating nations during 2000s (specifically fielded 2008–2010), including Australia, Austria, Canada, Chile, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, New Zealand, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Russian Federation, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, and the United States of America.

A four-wave panel dataset (2013–2018) tracking early integration processes, socio-economic status, demographic background, and living conditions of recent immigrants to the Netherlands during the 2010s.

returned_title: CBS StatLine - External migration; sex, age, marital status and country of birth (03742eng)
justification: Official Statistics Netherlands dataset providing annual data on international immigration, emigration, and net migration flow parameters across the 2010s disaggregated by country of birth, age, sex, and marital status.

returned_title: CBS StatLine - Population; sex, age, generation and migration background (37325)
justification: Statistics Netherlands historical demographic dataset documenting the resident population by migration background, migration generation, age, and sex covering 1996 to 2022.
Key population statistics published by Statistics Netherlands detailing net migration, population growth, and origin composition throughout the 2010s.
A representative longitudinal household survey initiated in West Germany in 1984, providing microeconomic time series on income, employment, living standards, and labor dynamics during the 1980s.

returned_title: Long Time Series on Economic Development in Germany (Deutsche Bundesbank)
justification: Provides official macroeconomic historical time series for Germany covering the 1980s, including national accounts, inflation rates, interest rates, money supply, and international trade balances.

returned_title: histat - Time Series on Historical Statistics of Germany
justification: A repository managed by the Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE containing historical quantitative time-series datasets on economic development, sector output, and social statistics in West and East Germany throughout the 1980s.

Initiated in 1991, this nationally representative UK longitudinal survey collected detailed annual household and individual data on marriage, cohabitation, family formation, and household relationships throughout the 1990s.

This 1994 iteration of the British Social Attitudes survey featured an International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) module specifically focused on attitudes towards family life, marriage, and changing gender roles in Great Britain.
Launched in the early 1990s, the Family Resources Survey collects comprehensive information on UK household compositions, marital statuses, and family living arrangements.

Surveys voters across European Union member states in 1994 (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, and Great Britain/Northern Ireland) on international politics, European integration, foreign policy attitudes, and EP election participation.

Archived at GESIS, this dataset collects individual-level survey data from 1994 on voter attitudes toward international politics, European Union institutions, national identity, and policy priorities in EU member countries.

Covers public opinion and voting behavior in the 1999 European Parliament elections across the EU-15 countries (including Austria, Sweden, Finland, Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, and the UK), focusing on European integration and international political issues.

Provides quantitative content-analytical data of electoral manifestos for political parties across democratic nations, including all 15 EU member states throughout the 1990s, tracking party positions on internationalism, European integration, peace, and international organisations.

Offers annual country-level political, institutional, and policy indicators for 36 OECD/EU democratic countries (including all requested European nations) for the 1990s, covering government composition, EU integration, and macro-political variables.

returned_title: EU Policy Agendas Project Dataset (Comparative Agendas Project)
justification: Tracks political agendas, policy priorities, and decision-making attention in European Union institutions and member states during the 1990s using standardized Comparative Agendas Project topic codes.

returned_title: Erwerbstätige nach Wirtschaftsbereichen auf dem Gebiet des heutigen NRW, 1850 bis 1970
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (Study ZA8685) provides historical statistics on the distribution of employed persons across economic sectors for cities and districts in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW) from 1850 through 1970, including the full decade of the 1960s.
This GESIS HISTAT dataset (Study ZA8686) contains workplace census data on employment within manufacturing and industrial sectors for North Rhine-Westphalia from 1850 to 1970.

returned_title: Erwerbstätigkeitsstatistik in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland: Ausgewählte Daten von 1950 bis 2000
justification: This GESIS HISTAT data compilation (Study ZA8184) presents official West German employment statistics and Microcensus time series broken down by federal states, covering employment in North Rhine-Westphalia throughout the 1960s.

Provides a digitized full-text search corpus of major East German daily newspapers ('Neues Deutschland', 'Berliner Zeitung', and 'Neue Zeit') spanning 1945/1946 to 1990/1994, capturing East German press and state media throughout the 1970s.

A 1973 empirical survey dataset conducted by the GDR's Central Institute for Youth Research (Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung), capturing media consumption, leisure habits, and cultural involvement of East German youth in the 1970s.

returned_title: Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen (GDR Television Audience Reaction Series)
justification: A series of sociological research datasets produced by the State Committee for Television (Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen) measuring television viewing habits, program ratings, and viewer engagement in the German Democratic Republic.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: Conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, this survey measures political attitudes, ideology, and social behavior among young citizens in East Germany in 1970.

returned_title: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS 1 - 1977 (10. Welle - Querschnitt)
justification: Part of the ZIJ longitudinal study series, this 1977 cross-sectional wave captures political attitudes, social behavior, and civic/political orientations of youth in the GDR during the late 1970s.

returned_title: The Potsdam Grievance Statistic File (PGSF) - Eingabestatistiken der DDR zwischen 1970 und 1989
justification: This dataset records political participation, quality-of-life concerns, and citizen complaints submitted through the GDR's official petitioning system ('Eingaben') across districts and counties continuously from 1970 to 1989.

returned_title: Federal Parliament Election 1972 (Panel: 2nd Wave, October 1971 - January 1972)
justification: This dataset is part of the NOS election study series (NOS-verkiezingsonderzoek, 1971-1972) archived by DANS and indexed in the CESSDA Data Catalogue under DOI 10.17026/DANS-2XT-AD3J.
This dataset, authored by Gertrud Beck and hosted by the GESIS Data Archive (Study ZA0529), examines the role of authority in political socialization among pre-school children and their parents.

returned_title: Sozialer Wandel und Gewaltkriminalität (Social Change and Violent Crime)
justification: This dataset, authored by Helmut Thome and Christoph Birkel and distributed by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences (Study No. ZA8194), examines long-term trends in social change and violent crime across Germany, England, and Sweden from 1950 to 2004.

returned_title: Sozialwissenschaftliche Telefonumfragen in der Allgemeinbevölkerung über das Mobilfunknetz (CELLA 1)
justification: This dataset, hosted by the GESIS Data Archive (ZA4875), contains the data from the CELLA 1 project on conducting social science telephone interviews among the general public via mobile phone and landline networks.

returned_title: Political Situation in West Berlin (Young People from the GDR)
justification: This dataset, archived in the GESIS Data Archive under Study No. ZA0590, contains survey data collected in January 1955 by the United States Information Agency (USIA) and DIVO regarding attitudes towards the economic and political situation in West Berlin from the perspective of young refugees from the GDR.
This dataset, archived by GESIS under study number ZA6621 and conducted on behalf of the German Federal Press Office, measures public trust in democracy, politics, parties, and media in Germany.

This dataset (Study ZA7315) contains survey data on television viewing behavior and audience responses in the German Democratic Republic (GDR) for week 5 of 1988, archived and distributed by the GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks 2014 (ESENER-2)
justification: This is the official DOI for the Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks 2014 (ESENER-2) dataset cataloged and distributed via GESIS Data Archive.

This dataset, archived by the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA0682, contains survey data commissioned by the Federal Centre for Health Education (BZgA) regarding attitudes toward family planning and contraception.

returned_title: Partnership Conflicts and Psychosomatic Gynecological Illnesses 1988/89 (Additional Survey: Sterile Women)
justification: This study/dataset (originally conducted in 1988/89 by J. Begenau and M. Rauchfuß at Humboldt University of Berlin / Charité under the German title 'Partnerschaftskonflikte und psychosomatische gynäkologische Erkrankungen') investigated partnership conflicts, sexuality, and psychosomatic symptoms among women in gynecological outpatient clinics in East Berlin, including an additional survey on sterile women.

returned_title: Sexual Conduct of Men and Women in the Federal Republic of Germany 1989
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study No. ZA2235) contains survey data collected in 1989 examining attitudes toward sexuality, AIDS, and sexual conduct among men and women in the Federal Republic of Germany.

returned_title: "Arma sunt necessaria" (Arms are necessary) Guns, Gun Culture and Cultural Origins of the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
justification: This work by Michael Lenz examines 18th-century gun culture and the cultural origins of the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, including the chapter titled "'Arma sunt necessaria': Guns and their Meaning in Eighteenth-Century Massachusetts and South Carolina" published by Böhlau Verlag.

The dataset 'A Survey of Europe Today (Finland)' (also indexed under 'A Survey of Europe Today (Finnland)'), part of the Reader's Digest cross-national consumer survey series, is available and indexed in the CESSDA Data Catalogue.

This dataset (German title: 'Hochschulausbildung und Beruf', GESIS study ZA1458), cataloged by CESSDA and hosted by the GESIS Data Archive, surveys college graduates from Munich regarding their school and learning conditions alongside their subsequent professional trajectories.

This dataset (GESIS Study ZA3222), conducted by IPOS and published via GESIS Data Archive, contains survey data on public perceptions, democracy judgments, and political expectations on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the Federal Republic of Germany.

returned_title: Future Plans of Young People at Special Schools of Emotional and Social Development
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study No. ZA6262), authored by Jakob Heuschmidt, investigates the future life plans and transition choices of young people attending special schools for emotional and social development in Germany.
This dataset portal hosted by Open Data Duisburg contains data, results, and reports for the Duisburg Citizen Survey (Duisburger Bürgerbefragung).

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 10 (Managers - Knowledge about European Institutions for economic support)
justification: Flash Eurobarometer 10 (Managers) corresponds to study ZA2146 from April 1992, cataloged and available via the GESIS Eurobarometer Flash Study Overview documentation page.

returned_title: Labour market policy in the German Empire.
justification: This historical dataset authored by Anselm Faust and hosted on the GESIS Data Archive (Study No. ZA8423) covers labor market policy, employment structures, and unemployment data in the German Empire.
The Duisburg Citizen Survey (Autumn 2002, Foreign population) dataset is archived at the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA4520 and accessible via DOI https://doi.org/10.4232/1.4520.

This dataset is part of the GESIS Data Archive study series on television viewing behavior and program evaluation in the German Democratic Republic (ZA7000–ZA7462) conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen. Study number ZA7140 corresponds to week 39 of 1984 (SFR 39/84), archived and published by GESIS.

returned_title: The Role of Women in the Informal sector: The Case of Ajegunle, Nigeria
justification: This dataset, archived in the GESIS Data Archive (ZA5004), covers the study on living conditions and economic activities of small business women in the informal sector, specifically including 'The Role of Women in the Informal sector: The Case of Ajegunle, Nigeria'.

returned_title: The CFS's (Center for Financial Studies) historical money and capital market data base, Germany 1871 to 1914
justification: This dataset, produced by the Center for Financial Studies at the University of Frankfurt and authored by Steffen Eube, Anja Weigt, and Johannes Müller, covers historical money and capital market time series for Germany between 1871 and 1914, available via the GESIS Data Archive.
This Bureau of Justice Statistics (BJS) dataset and report provides detailed statistics and characteristics of individuals under sentence of death and executed in the United States during 1978.

returned_title: Social Situation and Political Orientations of the Jena Populace before the Municipal Election in May 1990 (Soziale Situation und politische Orientierungen der Jenaer Bevölkerung vor der Kommunalwahl im Mai 1990)
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study ZA6350) captures the survey data regarding the social situation and political orientations of citizens in Jena prior to the municipal election in May 1990.

This dataset, preserved in the GESIS Data Archive, contains survey data from the 1945 study by Elihu Katz and Paul F. Lazarsfeld investigating opinion leadership, decision-making, and personal influence in Decatur, Illinois.

returned_title: LPA-AFLEK – Learning Progression Analytics - Analyse und Förderung von Lernverläufen zur Entwicklung von Kompetenzen
justification: This entry in the Verbund Forschungsdaten Bildung (VerbundFDB) portal provides the dataset and study details for Learning Progression Analytics - Analysing and Promoting Learning Progressions to Develop Skills (LPA-AFLEK).

This dataset (ZA7900) archived at the GESIS Data Archive contains the overall cumulative survey data for the 'Trend Questions Corona' (Trendfragen Corona) series commissioned by the Press and Information Office of the German Federal Government and conducted by forsa, including Week 13/2020.

returned_title: Vorbereitende Untersuchungen gemäß §141 BauGB und §165 Abs. 4 BauGB - [WMS]
justification: This dataset, provided via the Berlin Open Data portal by the Senate Department for Urban Development, Building and Housing, provides spatial boundaries for preparatory investigations conducted under urban planning and urban development promotion legislation (§ 141 and § 165 Abs. 4 BauGB / Städtebauförderungsgesetz).
This is the official dataset landing page and DOI for Wave 51 (January 2021) of the German Internet Panel (ZA7759) hosted at the GESIS Data Archive.
This is the official DOI link for the dataset 'Forsa-Bus 1992' (Study ZA3300) conducted by FORSA and published by the GESIS Data Archive.
This is the official primary dataset entry provided by GESIS Data Archive for Flash Eurobarometer 550 (EU Challenges and Priorities), registered with Digital Object Identifier 10.4232/1.14410.

This dataset, available in the GESIS Data Archive (ZA Study No. ZA2326), covers the economic situation of medium-sized companies in North Rhine-Westphalia and Rhineland-Palatinate, surveyed by Westdeutsche Genossenschafts-Zentralbank (WGZ-Bank).

returned_title: Southern Focus Poll, Combined Sample, Spring 1998
justification: While no dataset is titled strictly 'Spring Study 1998', this dataset from the Association of Religion Data Archives (ARDA) represents the Spring 1998 wave of the Southern Focus Poll survey series.
This dataset from the Middletown Area Study series was fielded in 1998 to assess social and religious attitudes in Delaware County, Indiana.

returned_title: The Berlin Pulse - German Foreign Policy 2024
justification: This dataset (GESIS study number ZA8996) contains public opinion survey data on German foreign policy conducted by Verian on behalf of the Körber-Stiftung and archived at GESIS.

returned_title: Youth Industrial Health and Safety in Practice in Hesse from the Perspective of Young People
justification: This is the official GESIS data catalog entry (ZA1376) for the dataset titled 'Youth Industrial Health and Safety in Practice in Hesse from the Perspective of Young People'.

returned_title: German Business Panel, Covid-19 Survey (2020/2021). Data file for on-site use
justification: This dataset, produced as part of the German Business Panel (GBP) longitudinal study, contains survey data from German firm executives on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and is distributed by GESIS for on-site use.

returned_title: histat - data compilation online: Wages and Salaries (Indices) in Germany 1913/14 - 2006
justification: This historical dataset, compiled by Jürgen Sensch and published by the GESIS Data Archive (ZA8614) as part of the histat collection, contains historical index time series on wages and salaries in Germany from 1913/14 to 2006.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 197 (Satisfaction with EC Representations in 11 Member States)
justification: This is the DOI link for the Flash Eurobarometer 197 dataset, archived and published by the GESIS Data Archive.
Official DOI landing page for the German General Social Survey - ALLBUScompact 2018 dataset (ZA5273) hosted by GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences.
This dataset, authored by Selcuk Timur Uluer and Lea Kaftan, presents the survey data collected from potential users of Monitoring Electoral Democracy (MEDem) in 2024.

returned_title: Foreigners in Eastern Germany 1990 (Ausländer in Ostdeutschland 1990)
justification: This study (GESIS Study No. ZA6342), conducted by the Berliner Institut für Sozialwissenschaftliche Studien (BISS) in 1990, surveyed foreign citizens living in Eastern Germany regarding their living conditions, migration intentions, and perceptions of relations between Germans and foreigners.

This dataset, available via the GESIS Data Archive, contains the survey data from the 2023/2024 winter semester study on the state of digitalisation in German higher education conducted by the mmb Institut on behalf of Hochschulforum Digitalisierung.

returned_title: Reader Analysis of the Mannesmann Company Magazine, UNSER WERKTAG
justification: This dataset (GESIS study ZA0265 / Emnid, 1967) contains survey and readership analysis data for the Mannesmann company magazine UNSER WERKTAG, archived in the GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: Dataset of Italian Municipal Unions (Intermunicipal Cooperation forms). 1996-2015
justification: This dataset was created by Silvia Bolgherini, Mattia Casula, and Mariano Marotta (2018) to analyze forms of intermunicipal cooperation and municipal unions in Italy from 1996 to 2015, and is cataloged in the IRIS institutional research repository.
This dataset (GESIS Study No. ZA2546) provides survey data on political opinions, party preferences, and voting attitudes in West Germany throughout 1994.

This dataset, compiled by Peter Lundgreen and Gudrun Schwibbe and archived by GESIS, contains historical time-series data on higher education institutions in the Federal Republic of Germany covering the period from 1949 to 2001.

returned_title: Das Wachstum der deutschen Wirtschaft seit der Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts. Kapitel: Bevölkerung und Beschäftigung (The Growth of the German Economy since the Middle of the 19th Century. Chapter: Population and Employment)
justification: This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive contains historical economic time series corresponding to the 'Population and Employment' chapter of Walther G. Hoffmann's landmark study 'Das Wachstum der deutschen Wirtschaft seit der Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts'.

returned_title: Social Structure in the Lignite Area West of the Rhine (Relocated Villages)
justification: This is the primary dataset record cataloged in the GESIS Data Archive (ZA Study No. 0258 / DOI 10.4232/1.0258) covering the socio-structural research on relocated villages in the Rhenish lignite mining district.

This dataset, titled 'Education and Life' (GESIS Study No. ZA1441), is archived in the GESIS Data Archive and contains longitudinal survey data re-interviewing former high school students on their occupational and private life outcomes.

returned_title: CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia
justification: CROCorp is a dataset containing cleaned and pre-processed parliamentary debates from the Croatian Parliament (Sabor) covering five complete terms from 2003 to 2020, along with metadata on elected representatives and political parties.

This dataset (GESIS study number ZA8738) comprises representative population survey data collected by forsa on behalf of the Press and Information Office of the German Federal Government from February 19 to 21, 2024 (Week 8/2024), focusing on public concerns, political attitudes, and social issues in Germany.

returned_title: Attitudes to Demonstrations by Young People
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study ZA0323), conducted by EMNID in June 1968, covers West German public attitudes toward youth demonstrations and the SDS (Sozialistischer Deutscher Studentenbund).
The dataset 'Partners III - Apprentices 1990' is indexed and accessible in the CESSDA Data Catalogue, provided by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences.
The monthly Politbarometer survey for October 1987 is archived and published by GESIS as part of the 1987 cumulated dataset (ZA Study No. ZA1899).

This dataset (GESIS study number ZA5575) contains the 2010 survey data from the long-term research project on Group-Oriented Animosity Against People (Gruppenbezogene Menschenfeindlichkeit) led by Wilhelm Heitmeyer and colleagues, published via the GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: Schoolchildren Interval Study Health Education and Maintaining Health 1987 to 1991 (Waves 1 to 3)
justification: This dataset corresponds to the Schoolchildren Interval Study focusing on Health Education and Maintaining Health from 1987 to 1991 (Waves 1 to 3), preserved and cataloged by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences under DOI 10.4232/1.6564 (ZA6564).

returned_title: Social and Political Attitudes 2024 (Cumulated Data Set)
justification: This survey dataset on social and political attitudes in Germany in 2024 was conducted by forsa on behalf of the Federal Government's Press and Information Office and is archived at GESIS.

This dataset contains sociological survey data on audience viewership and television program evaluations in the GDR during week 30 of 1984, published by the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA7131.

returned_title: Personality, Motives, and Human Capital as Explanations for Business Success (GESIS ZA4659)
justification: This dataset is archived in the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA4659 (German title: 'Persönlichkeit, Motive, und Humankapital als Prädikatoren für den Geschäftserfolg') and investigates personality traits, motives, and human capital factors as predictors of business success.

returned_title: Code/Syntax: Homeoffice und suchthaftes Arbeiten in Deutschland
justification: This data and code repository, authored by Christian Ebner, Beatrice van Berk, and Daniela Rohrbach-Schmidt, contains the replication syntax for the study on work addiction and working from home in Germany and is hosted at GESIS under DOI 10.7802/2567.

returned_title: Young People in Organized Leisure Time
justification: This dataset, cataloged by GESIS (Study No. ZA0527) and available via the CESSDA Data Catalogue, examines the significance of leisure clubhouses and organized leisure-time activities for young people in Germany.

This dataset belongs to the GESIS Data Archive collection of GDR television audience research studies ('Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen', covering 1980–1990 under study numbers ZA7000–ZA7462), conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen, Abteilung Soziologische Forschung, Berlin.

This dataset, archived by GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences under study reference ZA5642 (Landtagswahl im Saarland 2012), contains survey and voting behavior data from the 2012 Saarland state election.

returned_title: Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany
justification: This is the official DOI landing page for the GESIS dataset ZA3331 titled 'Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany'.

returned_title: Food for Justice: Power, Politics, and Food Inequalities in a Bioeconomy (Berlin, 2024)
justification: This dataset, hosted on GESIS, contains survey data collected during the 2024 'Wir haben es satt!' protest in Berlin as part of the Food for Justice research project.

returned_title: Code/Syntax: Socio-Economic Status, Comparisons of Subjective Affectedness and Life Satisfaction During the COVID-19 Pandemic in Germany
justification: This dataset repository hosted on GESIS contains the code and syntax files used to replicate the analyses in the study on socio-economic status, comparisons of subjective affectedness, and life satisfaction during the COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.

This dataset, archived by GESIS (ZA6363), contains survey data collected in September 1988 by the Hochschule für Architektur und Bauwesen Weimar regarding housing conditions, leisure time, and neighborhood relations in Jena.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Relations and Support Systems - ISSP 2001
justification: This is the official DOI landing page for the dataset 'International Social Survey Programme: Social Relations and Support Systems - ISSP 2001' (Study number ZA3680) provided by the GESIS Data Archive.
This is the official DOI landing page for Flash Eurobarometer 313 (ZA5473) hosted by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences.

returned_title: Based on ISSP 2018: A Cross-national and Comparative Study of Religion of Additional 14 Countries
justification: This dataset (GESIS Data Archive ZA7630) provides the survey data for the ISSP 2018 Religion IV module collected in 14 additional non-ISSP-member countries.
This dataset, collected by the United States Information Agency (USIA) between January and February 1963, is archived at the GESIS Data Archive under Study No. ZA1976.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 383 (Firearms in the European Union)
justification: This is the persistent DOI leading to the official Flash Eurobarometer 383 (ZA5897) dataset page hosted in the GESIS Data Archive.

This dataset is part of the 'Party Preferences Czech Republic (Trend)' survey series archived at the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences, capturing public opinion and voting intentions in the Czech Republic during the year 2000.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: National Identity III - ISSP 2013 (Netherlands)
justification: This dataset provides the Dutch national data for the 2013 International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) module on National Identity III, deposited at the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA5517.

returned_title: Wahl- und Sozialdaten der Kreise und Gemeinden des Deutschen Reiches von 1920 bis 1933
justification: This GESIS Data Archive study contains municipality-level and district-level historical voting data for Reichstag elections and other Weimar-era votes across Germany, including the city of Kiel.

returned_title: Wahlen und Abstimmungen in der Weimarer Republik, 1919-1933
justification: This GESIS dataset covers electoral results for Reichstag elections and the 1925 and 1932 Reich Presidential elections across electoral constituencies and regions in the Weimar Republic.

returned_title: Attitudes to Security Policy in the Federal Republic (November - December 1982)
justification: This dataset, archived at the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA1853, contains survey data on public attitudes toward foreign and security policy in the Federal Republic of Germany from November to December 1982.
This dataset, authored by Klaus Boers and Jost Reinecke, contains survey data on youth delinquency and victimization from the study 'Crime in the Modern City' conducted in 2007, archived at GESIS.
This is the Scientific Use File (SUF) for the German Microcensus 1998 (MZ 1998) published by the Research Data Center (Forschungsdatenzentrum).
This is the anonymized Campus File (CF) dataset for the German Microcensus 1998 (MZ 1998) designed for research and academic instruction.
This is the official persistent DOI landing page for the German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) dataset titled Long-term Online Tracking, T27 (ZA5727) hosted in the GESIS Data Archive.
The dataset titled 'Comparative National Development Project (Uruguay)', conducted by Seymour Martin Lipset, is archived and made available through GESIS under DOI 10.4232/1.0401.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV - ISSP 2015 (Turkey)
justification: This dataset represents the Turkey country data for the ISSP 2015 Work Orientations IV module, archived as a standalone dataset (ZA5520) in the GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: EVS - European Values Study 1999 - Great Britain
justification: This dataset contains the Great Britain national survey from the 1999 European Values Study wave, hosted at GESIS Data Archive under Study No. ZA3777.
This dataset is published by the GESIS Data Archive (Study No. ZA1439) under the exact title 'Young People and Adults '85 (Adult)'.
This is the official GESIS dataset landing page and persistent identifier (DOI) for Flash Eurobarometer 223, which covers public opinion on the changeover to the euro in Malta.

This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive (Study No. ZA1536) contains the monthly Politbarometer trend survey waves leading up to the 1987 German Bundestag election, including the November 1986 survey wave.
This dataset is archived in the GESIS Data Archive for Social Sciences (Study No. ZA7226) as part of the historical DDR television audience research series.

returned_title: Representatives in the Reichstag in the Weimar Republic 1919-1933
justification: This dataset, authored by Heinrich Best and deposited at the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA8007, contains collective biographical and parliamentary data on members of the Reichstag during the Weimar Republic (1919–1933).
This dataset is archived in the GESIS Data Archive under DOI 10.4232/1.6543, covering radio audience participation and listening habits for the broadcast 'Berliner Luft' in February 1989.

This dataset (GESIS Study ZA2937) contains survey data collected across European Union member states between April and June 1997 covering topics such as European citizens' rights, women and cancer prevention, attitudes towards the European Parliament, and expectations of the European Union.
This dataset, authored by Josef Greber and archived at the GESIS Data Archive (Study No. ZA0418), collects social and economic survey data on the shoemaker's trade in North Rhine-Westphalia.
This is the primary DOI and dataset record for GLES Tracking October 2022, T53 (ZA7711) provided by GESIS - Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences.

This dataset, authored by Inga Brentel and published via GESIS (SowiDataNet|datorium), details process step 3 ('Harmonisierung Anwenden' mit charmstana) for the data preparation of the MA-IntermediaPlus.

returned_title: EUvox2014: Voting Advice Application data for the 2014 European Parliament elections
justification: This dataset, hosted on GESIS Datorium, contains the user response data and associated materials from the EUvox2014 Voting Advice Application collected during the 2014 European Parliament election campaign.
This is the official DOI for the dataset Prevention Survey Rhineland-Palatinate (2006 and 2010) (GESIS Study No. ZA5533), published by GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: Interval Study: Development Factors and Development Forms of Young People in the GDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3rd Wave)
justification: This dataset represents the third wave (1970) of the IS I panel series (1968–1980) conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, archived and made available via the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA6151.

returned_title: Meinungsbarometer Januar/Februar 1990 - Einstellung zur Entwicklung in der DDR
justification: GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA6010) containing public opinion survey data collected in East Germany in late January and early February 1990.
GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA1920) containing monthly Politbarometer West trend survey data for 1990, including February 1990.

returned_title: Political Action: An Eight Nation Study, 1973-1976
justification: Conducted between 1973 and 1976 across eight nations including West Germany, this dataset contains cross-sectional survey data and parent-child dyad data covering West German voting behavior, party preferences, political attitudes, satisfaction with democracy, subjective social class identity, family political socialization, economic expectations, and issue priorities regarding the environment, inflation, and protest.

Initiated in 1977 by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen and archived at GESIS (ZA2391), this monthly time-series survey captures West German political attitudes, voting intentions, party preferences, evaluations of chancellor candidates and top politicians, economic expectations, and priorities on key political issues including inflation, environmental policy, and peace negotiations.

Archived at GESIS (ZA0626), this 1970 survey measures West German public opinion, political attitudes toward democratic governance, party and political orientations, subjective social standing, economic expectations, and priorities on international affairs, defense, and peace policy at the beginning of the 1970s.

This dataset, created by Gertrud Beck at the University of Gießen (Hesse) in 1969, focuses on the role of authority in political socialization during preschool age. It features survey data from both preschool children and their parents, covering family authority structures, parents' child-rearing practices, attitudes toward authority and punishment, educational goals, perceptions of public authority figures, and demographic household characteristics.

Compiled by Wolfram Schulz and Harold Hurwitz (FU Berlin) and archived at GESIS (ZA8081), this dataset contains election results and census indicators for Berlin districts from 1930 to 1963. It includes detailed 1950s data on political preferences, voting behavior, population demographics, age distribution, employment, and housing conditions in postwar West Berlin.

Conducted by Gabriel Almond and Sidney Verba and distributed by ICPSR, this foundational survey includes respondents from West Germany (including West Berlin) in the late 1950s. It captures post-war political behavior and attitudes, opinions on government institutions, economic recovery, rearmament, civic engagement, and comparisons between political systems.

This biennial survey contains representative data on the German population's political attitudes, trust in democratic institutions, political participation, media consumption, and general opinions on Germany's political situation in 2018.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2017 - Post-election Cross-Section
justification: Part of the GLES project for the 2017 German federal election, this dataset covers opinions on political parties, candidates, trust in democracy, media consumption during the campaign, and voter behavior.

A cumulated dataset of monthly survey waves conducted in 2015 that measures public opinion in Germany regarding government performance, trust in politics, evaluations of parties and top politicians, and political attitudes.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2017 - Short-term Campaign Panel
justification: A multi-wave panel survey collected during the 2017 election campaign in Germany, capturing dynamic changes in political media usage, party/politician ratings, political participation, and views on the German political system.

Conducted by the GDR's Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen (Sociological Research Department) in 1987, this dataset measures audience participation, TV viewing behavior, evaluation of TV moderators, program realism/plot ratings, overall impressions, and respondent demographics.

Part of the GESIS dataset collection 'Watching Television in the GDR (1982-1990)', this weekly survey collects GDR television audience participation numbers, program ratings, evaluation of specific show components, and detailed viewer demographics.

This 1986 dataset records GDR viewer participation and evaluation of specific programs and series (e.g., Der schwarze Kanal, Asse im Spiel), assessing entertainment value, format realism, viewer satisfaction, and demographic background.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 (ESENER-2)
justification: Conducted in 2014 across 36 European countries (including EU Member States and non-EU countries in the prompt), this establishment-level survey captures responses from safety and health management representatives across public and private workplaces on occupational safety and health management, psychosocial risk factors (work-related stress, violence, harassment), musculoskeletal risks, risk assessment practices, worker participation, and organizational drivers and barriers.

returned_title: Third European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2019 (ESENER-3)
justification: Conducted in 2019 across 33 European countries, this dataset provides establishment-level survey data from public and private workplaces on health and safety management practices, psychosocial risk management (stress, bullying, harassment), physical risk factors including musculoskeletal disorders, risk assessment implementation, employee participation, and organizational drivers and barriers.

returned_title: European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2009 (ESENER-1)
justification: Conducted at the threshold of the 2010s across 31 European countries, this establishment-level dataset covers occupational safety and health management, psychosocial risks, risk assessment procedures, worker representation, and drivers and barriers in European workplaces.

Conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in Leipzig, this East German (GDR) survey collected data entering the 1980s regarding partnership quality, sexuality, contraception, family planning, partner relations, and gender role expectations.

Administered by ZIJ Leipzig and the Research Center for Partner and Sexual Research, this GDR dataset focuses on East German university students, capturing detailed data on sexuality, contraception, partnership quality, domestic arrangements, reproductive health, and gender roles.

A longitudinal study conducted in the GDR between 1982 and 1988 by ZIJ Leipzig tracking living and study conditions, physical and psychological health, drug use, contraception, pregnancy, partnership relations, family life, housing, and work-family balance.

An interval panel survey from the GDR during the 1980s that tracks young people's attitudes and behaviors regarding sexuality, partner relationships, gender role orientations, health, and family planning.

returned_title: Sexualverhalten von Männern und Frauen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1988
justification: This representative GESIS dataset from 1988 covers sexual behavior, attitudes toward sexuality and AIDS, condom use, partner relationships, and sexual practices among men and women in West Germany during the 1980s.

returned_title: Einstellungen zu Sexualität und AIDS (Attitude to Sexuality and AIDS)
justification: Archived at the GESIS Data Archive, this survey investigates public attitudes toward sexuality, HIV/AIDS knowledge, risk perception, prevention behaviors, and partner relationships in Germany during the late 1980s.

returned_title: AIDS im öffentlichen Bewußtsein der Bundesrepublik 1991-1992 (Kumulierter Datensatz)
justification: Part of the long-running annual survey series commissioned by the Federal Centre for Health Education (BZgA) starting in 1987, this dataset measures knowledge, attitudes, condom use, risk behaviors, and the social impact of HIV/AIDS in Germany.

Conducted around 1990 by the AG Sexualität (Forschungsstelle Partner- und Sexualforschung), this survey collects data on partnership development, sexual behavior, first sexual contacts, contraceptive choices, sexual practices, and attitudes regarding AIDS.

This dataset provides microdata transcribed from 18th-century probate inventory samples (1773–1775) across 21 colonial counties, including Massachusetts and South Carolina. It contains specific information on firearm ownership (counts, weapon types, and monetary values), slaveholding, decedent demographics, county/locality, and overall estate wealth.

Created by Alice Hanson Jones, this landmark probate inventory collection includes microdata on 919 decedents from 1774 across colonial counties in New England, Middle, and Southern regions (including Massachusetts and South Carolina). It records itemized personal property including firearms, total estate value, slaveholding, gender, and locality.

returned_title: Readers Digest Survey of Europe Today, 1969
justification: This 1969 cross-national survey dataset covers 16 Western European nations including Finland. It contains data on household consumption, durable goods, car ownership, drinking habits, media use, travel, advertising attitudes, social tolerance, public opinions on the EEC, as well as demographic and housing characteristics.

This dataset from GESIS (collected in 1975 by the Deutsches Jugendinstitut München) surveys graduates of the University and Technical College of Munich who completed their studies in 1972. It contains individual-level data directly covering educational pathways, family social background, study interruptions between secondary school and higher education, career choices, job characteristics, workplace attitudes, income, and life satisfaction in 1970s Bavaria.

Conducted by the Institut für praxisorientierte Sozialforschung (IPOS) in May 1999 specifically for the 50th anniversary of the Federal Republic of Germany, this dataset contains survey data on Germans' evaluations of democracy and the political system, party preference, reunification, social market economy, optimism about Germany's future, and demographic characteristics.

This 1998 wave of the ALLBUS survey provides population-representative data on social conditions, economic evaluations, attitudes toward democratic institutions, party preferences, and demographic indicators in East and West Germany in the late 1990s.

Distributed by GESIS, this dataset collects data on political attitudes, party preferences, candidate evaluations, government performance, and voting behavior in Germany around the 1998 federal election.

returned_title: Zukunft_EmSoz - Zukunftsentwürfe von Jugendlichen an Förderschulen der emotionalen und sozialen Entwicklung
justification: This dataset specifically investigates the future life plans and aspirations of adolescents attending special schools (Förderschulen) for emotional and social development in Germany. It collects comprehensive data on youth expectations regarding employment, family life, housing, finances, leisure activities, and political/civic participation, along with relevant demographic information such as school type and migration background.

This GESIS survey dataset covers Duisburg (NRW) residents in spring 2000, measuring housing conditions and satisfaction, municipal administration and local politics, local economic climate, public services, leisure activities, museum use, transport, and demographic characteristics.

This survey dataset collects representative data from Duisburg residents in autumn 2000 on housing satisfaction, local economic perceptions, municipal government and politics, public services, living environment, and demographics.

This dataset provides survey data from autumn 2001 on Duisburg residents' housing conditions and satisfaction, local economic perceptions, local politics and municipal administration, public services, and sociodemographic characteristics.

Conducted in September 1993 across the EC12 countries (Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain), this Flash Eurobarometer dataset surveys business managers on their awareness and use of EU institutions supporting small and medium-sized businesses, information sources, knowledge of European business promotion events, foreign support organizations, and firm characteristics.

This dataset from the Flash Eurobarometer series targets business managers across European Union member states, covering business management, industrial organisation, perceptions of EU institutions, and support mechanisms for small and medium-sized enterprises.

This GESIS dataset (ZA3469) provides survey data collected in Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia in Autumn 2000. It covers housing satisfaction, living conditions, environmental problems, interethnic relations, discrimination, German language skills, media use, and contacts with municipal administration among local residents.

Conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen (Abteilung Soziologische Forschung) in the German Democratic Republic, this weekly survey captures television viewing behavior, program awareness, ratings and evaluations of specific GDR TV programs and presenters, media usage habits, and individual demographic characteristics.

Part of the GDR sociological audience research series from the 1980s stored at GESIS, capturing weekly audience participation, viewing habits, evaluations of television broadcasts, household media equipment, and detailed demographic attributes of respondents in East Germany.

returned_title: Interessen, Wünsche und Erwartungen von Kinobesuchern 1989 [ZA6047]
justification: Conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in Leipzig in 1989, this survey covers cinema attendance, interest in DEFA films and cinema scheduling, frequency of watching films on GDR television, general leisure and media preferences, and respondent demographic characteristics.

Created by Margaret Peil and archived at the UK Data Service, this survey covers Ajegunle (Lagos) alongside other Nigerian cities. It collects empirical data on women and men regarding household living conditions, migration patterns, housing, occupations, income, business activities of traders and craftswomen, associational/union involvement, and unemployment.

Created by SAFE in collaboration with Goethe University, this dataset provides monthly time series from 1871 to 1914 covering 1,459 firms across six regional German stock exchanges, including stock prices, dividend payments, capital levels, and industry classifications.

returned_title: The long-term rate of return of german stock 1870 to 1959 (GESIS ZA8281)
justification: Compiled by Ulrich Ronge and archived at GESIS, this dataset offers historical capital market time series for Germany from 1870 onwards, including nominal and price-adjusted stock market indices and annual returns covering the German Reich period before WWI.

returned_title: Time series of money in circulation in Germany between 1870 and 1913 (GESIS ZA8230)
justification: Compiled by Richard H. Tilly, this GESIS dataset contains historical time series on money supply, banknote circulation, bank deposits, metallic money, and financial market indicators in the German Empire from 1870 to 1913.

returned_title: Index of Stock Prices for Germany (NBER Macrohistory Database / FRED)
justification: Hosted on FRED from the NBER Macrohistory Database, this dataset provides monthly time series of German stock price indices covering the period from January 1870 through December 1913.

returned_title: Bevölkerung und Recht in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland (Population and Law in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1970)
justification: This 1970 survey dataset (GESIS Study ZA0641) examines public opinions on law, judicial institutions, law enforcement, punishment goals, and attitudes toward capital punishment (Todesstrafe) in West Germany. It contains comprehensive socio-demographic variables matching the query requirement: age, sex, marital status, religion and religiosity, general and vocational education, employment and occupation, household income, household composition/children, city size, and state (Bundesland).

returned_title: Political Attitudes in East and West, March 1990 (Comparative Survey FRG - GDR)
justification: This GESIS comparative survey conducted in March 1990 measures political attitudes, evaluations of politicians and parties, and expected socio-economic changes across both the GDR and FRG during the transition period.

returned_title: Mecklenburg-West Pomerania and Saxony in Advance of the State Parliament Elections 1990
justification: Focuses on former East German territories (GDR) in 1990, capturing survey data on local political attitudes, party preferences, municipal election influences, and evaluations of candidate competence.

Provides harmonized municipality-level panel data on municipal, state, and federal elections across former GDR and FRG regions starting in the 1990s, measuring voter turnout, political representation, and party performance.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: National Identity I - ISSP 1995
justification: Includes survey data from Germany in the mid-1990s covering work and geographic mobility, housing and living conditions, local community attachment, and citizen attitudes toward government representation.

Conducted in Decatur, Illinois in 1945 by Elihu Katz and Paul F. Lazarsfeld, this classic study investigates interpersonal opinion leaders and social networks. It examines the influence of opinion leaders on consumer choices (marketing), fashion, political attitudes, moviegoing, and mass media usage, and includes a follow-up panel survey of nominated influencers with demographic variables.

Archived at the GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, this survey series provides cross-sectional data from West Germany (including North Rhine-Westphalia and the Cologne region) collected throughout the 1980s, covering leisure activities, shopping and consumer habits, car ownership, commuting/travel behavior, housing tenure, and respondent demographics.

returned_title: Allgemeine Bevölkerungsumfrage der Sozialwissenschaften ALLBUScompact - Kumulation 1980-2010
justification: Curated by GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, this dataset contains cumulative survey modules from 1980 onward covering population demographics, housing conditions, consumer behavior, travel/commuting patterns, and leisure engagement in North Rhine-Westphalia.

returned_title: European Values Study Longitudinal Data File 1981-2008 (EVS 1981-2008)
justification: Distributed by GESIS Data Archive, this dataset includes survey waves starting in 1981 that examine social values, community and urban life, leisure habits, consumer behavior, and demographic profiles across West Germany, including North Rhine-Westphalia.

returned_title: GESIS Panel.pop Special Survey on the Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 Outbreak in Germany
justification: This dataset provides representative population survey data collected in Germany during the 2020 COVID-19 outbreak. It covers infection risk perceptions, evaluations of government measures, changes in working conditions (including home office), media consumption, and demographic characteristics including age, sex, education, income, and region.

COSMO Germany consists of 69 serial cross-sectional representative population surveys conducted between 2020 and 2023. It contains variables on infection worries, information levels, trust in government and health policies, work/life changes, and comprehensive participant demographics.

returned_title: SOEP-CoV: Socio-Economic Panel COVID-19 Study in Germany
justification: SOEP-CoV is a representative longitudinal survey of private households in Germany during 2020 and 2021. It examines COVID-19 health risks, labor market and home office arrangements, policy perceptions, and rich demographic information including age, sex, education, household income, region, and political preferences.

returned_title: Preparatory Investigation according to the Law to Promote Urban Development (Municipality Data)
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA1157), compiled by the Arbeitsgruppe Stadtforschung at the University of Oldenburg, provides aggregate data on urban renewal areas (Sanierungsgebiete) in West Germany. It covers structural and socioeconomic indicators including building density, company/business structure, housing quality, demographics, employment, household composition, renters, foreign residents, and local planning processes.

Conducted by the Städtebauinstitut Nürnberg in 1968, this GESIS dataset (ZA0488) collects empirical data on urban development areas in West Germany, examining neighborhood infrastructure, building conditions, housing quality, heating/facilities, and household demographics.

This 1969 dataset (ZA0551) from GESIS captures housing and living conditions across urban areas in West Germany, measuring structural building damage, commercial usage, tenant satisfaction, household structure, and local civic participation indicators.

The German Internet Panel (GIP) is a long-term, probability-based online panel study operated by the University of Mannheim in cooperation with GESIS. Running bi-monthly through the 2020s, it collects internet-based survey data from Germany on individual attitudes and preferences relevant to political and economic decision-making, covering employment, social welfare policy, political behaviour, health, migration, and government policy reforms.

The GESIS Panel is an open probability-based mixed-mode (predominantly web-based) longitudinal survey of the general population in Germany running through the 2020s. It regularly measures political attitudes and behaviour, economic decision-making, employment status, social welfare preferences, health conditions, and views on migration and social service availability.

The GLES Panel is a primary web-based longitudinal survey tracking political and societal attitudes, political behaviour, voting choices, government system evaluations, and economic preferences among eligible voters in Germany throughout the 2020s.

returned_title: GESIS Panel Special Survey on the Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 Outbreak in Germany
justification: Conducted in 2020 using the GESIS Panel online infrastructure, this high-frequency panel dataset collects individual data in Germany regarding specific diseases and medical conditions (COVID-19), health behaviors, trust in government, political attitudes, employment changes, and social welfare support.

This dataset consists of daily representative CATI telephone survey data of eligible voters in Germany collected throughout 1992 by the FORSA polling institute. It covers individual political attitudes, candidate and party preferences, voting behavior in past elections, and economic expectations.

Part of the ongoing FORSA daily omnibus survey series in Germany, this 1995 annual accumulation captures around 500 telephone interviews per day of eligible voters on political preferences, past voting behavior, government competence, and economic development.

returned_title: Research Data Center Elections at GESIS - Forsa-Bus Data Series
justification: The Research Data Center Elections at GESIS archives and provides academic access to the entire Forsa-Bus collection (available from 1991 onwards), which tracks political attitudes, party and chancellor preferences, and voting behavior of eligible voters in Germany on a daily basis.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 550: EU Challenges and Priorities
justification: Fielded in June and July 2024 across all 27 EU Member States, this Eurobarometer survey provides public opinion data specifically evaluating EU citizens' perceptions of the main challenges facing the EU (such as the war in Ukraine, irregular migration, and climate change) and their top policy priorities for the European Union.

Fielded in April 2024 across the EU-27, Standard Eurobarometer 101 measures European public opinion on international politics, security and defence, satisfaction with EU democracy, and citizen priorities regarding key geopolitical and economic challenges.

Conducted in early 2024 in all 27 EU Member States prior to the European Parliament elections, this dataset captures public opinion on political priorities (such as fighting poverty, public health, and EU defence), political behavior, and citizens' views on the EU's position in global politics.

This dataset (GESIS Study ZA2326) contains survey data collected by Westdeutsche Genossenschafts-Zentralbank (WGZ-Bank) on medium-sized companies in North Rhine-Westphalia and Rhineland-Palatinate for 1991–1992. It covers company business conditions, turnover, costs, sales prices, profit margins, capital endowment, investment motives, self-financing and loan financing, as well as sales and investment expectations in the former East Germany and Eastern Europe.

returned_title: Lagebericht Mittelstand im Sommer 1992 (Situation Report Medium-Sized Companies in Summer 1992)
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study ZA2327) surveyed medium-sized enterprises in the Rhenish-Westphalian region during summer 1992 regarding current business situation, turnover, cost developments, investment plans, financing proportions, and expectations for business in the second half of 1992.

This GESIS dataset contains representative survey data collected across 1998 leading up to the 1998 German federal election, capturing party identification, vote intentions, candidate and party evaluations, issue competence, political attitudes, and demographics.

returned_title: Politische Einstellungen, politische Partizipation und Wählerverhalten im vereinigten Deutschland 1998 (Deutsche Nationale Wahlstudie 1998)
